title: Genomic Sovereignty: Integrating Precision Medicine into Vermont’s Primary Care Ecosystem
summary: A visionary analysis of the data infrastructure required to move genomic sequencing from specialized research labs into daily clinical practice.

children.text: Precision medicine is the ultimate data-efficiency tool. By integrating genomic markers directly into the EMR, we transition from reactive, 'one-size-fits-all' medicine to targeted therapeutic pathways. The technical challenge is the sheer volume of data: a single human genome requires roughly 200GB of storage, necessitating a radical rethink of our state HIE architecture.
We are moving toward a future where a patient's genetic code is as fundamental to their chart as their blood pressure.
